title: Evidence-gated post-render repair compiler + executable persistence enforcement

source_provenance.locator: 2026-08-21 directive: add concrete engineering modules/contracts and connect self-improvement engine

source_provenance.notes: Existing persistence law; candidate extends enforcement, not policy

problem_or_opportunity: Correct persistence and selective-repair laws existed, but the E01 full master pointer could not reacquire bytes and downstream post-render work lacked a single schema-versioned executable chain from cue lineage through selective repair regression.
proposed_mechanism: At critical-master acceptance enforce byte/readback escrow; for post-render repair use semantic cue lineage -> accepted/live timing -> signal intervals -> evidence classification -> selective repair plan -> explicit asset/gain patch render -> byte-level regression -> real human listen.
expected_benefit: Makes audio repair deterministic, fail-closed, auditable and reusable while reducing blanket fixes and protecting locked story/accepted audio.

success_tests: same schemas/modules operate without ROOM917-specific code changes
human listen shows no causal/story regression

pilot_evidence: 13 production-grounded E01 Scene1/2 semantic blocks compile with no invented timestamps
synthetic chain authorized exactly one room-bed patch and held two non-authorized intervals
room-bed renderer changed only authorized range with explicit asset+gain
deliberate unauthorized change FAIL as required
integration exposed and repaired two schema/interface mismatches
red_team_findings: Project success must not auto-promote to domain law
Level alone cannot prove missing Foley or authorize patch
Canonical module interfaces require schema-versioning and backward-compatible read boundaries
next_action: Replicate unchanged core mechanism on a second independent locked audio project, then reconcile into central CURRENT_IMPROVEMENT_REGISTRY only after SI-0008 transcript-recovery write-through is complete.
hold_trigger: Second suitable audio project with immutable master bytes, explicit cue contracts and human listen available.
